title: Conjured
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. **Scope rule** (user, 2026-09-30): every actor that exists only as a summon, reached from a `MagicEffect` (or a leveled list that one uses), never from a placed reference. A placed or quest-spawned version of the same creature stays with its own family (Daedra, Undead). Each family page has a *Summoned by* table: the spell, how the player gets it, and the NPCs that cast it.
